findings.text: Still open from attempt 1: REQ-9 and REQ-6 let staff cancel an appointment after its start time, but the glossary defines Cancelled as called off before it took place. A-03's mismatch records only the glossary#scheduled clash, not this one.

rubric_items.reason: All four ticket acceptance criteria map to REQ-1, REQ-2, REQ-4 and REQ-5; job frequency is listed under Out of scope with a reason.
Previous F-2 fixed: Cancelled (REQ-6) and No-show (REQ-16) are now separate REQs; each REQ states one checkable behaviour.
Every known status cites the ticket or an IDE answer (A-01 to A-07), and the cited answers say what the artifact claims.

The Scheduled-only-can-change clash was asked (Q-03) and recorded as a mismatch, but the clash with glossary Cancelled ('before it took place') for cancelling a past or Stale appointment is still not recorded.
Q-01 to Q-05 offered real options with defaults and were answered; none remain open needlessly.
Plain wording; glossary terms used consistently, and 'reschedule' is tied to the glossary term 'move'.
